notes: Every sale and purchase now needs a mobile number (the name is optional), so no bill is left with nobody to collect from; the same number always goes to the same customer, and saved customers are listed as you type. A bill saved earlier with nobody on it can be given its customer: open it and tap Add customer to this bill. Home's To Collect now counts such bills. Fixed: goods bought at a discount now cost what you paid, so the profit on them is right; Reports show the discounts on purchases. A customer's or supplier's page has one sum (total, paid, left) and each bill says what was paid. Balances read To Collect and To Pay everywhere. A printed bill adds what was paid later and prints the balance as it stands now. Also in this version: Cash or Bank everywhere, Cash and Bank history, the business report (MIS) as PDF, Excel or CSV, expenses paid from Outside, a shorter side bar, and shop details on one page (My shop).
